narrative.summary: PoolAddressesProvider.owner() is SparkProxy, whose three wards are Sky’s MCD_PAUSE_PROXY (behind the same 2-day-delay governance already scored for MCD_PAUSE), an ESM whose threshold is set to the uint256 maximum so it cannot fire, and StarGuard, itself warded only by MCD_PAUSE_PROXY. A separate FreezerMom can freeze or pause markets with no delay, through the Sky Chief’s current hat or a 3-of-5 Safe.
narrative.tag: cross-exposure: 80, same Sky root as MCD_PAUSE
narrative.detail: The instant seat can only freeze or pause markets, an availability risk rather than fund redirection, and it is why timelockScore is 60 instead of MCD_PAUSE’s 70. Two other RISK_ADMIN holders (KillSwitchOracle and CapAutomator) are automated contracts administered by SparkProxy, disclosed but not scored.
